title: Order Granting Motion (Docket No. 26-057-05)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Formal Complaint of Richard Timothy 
Branscomb on behalf of Sierra West 
Diamonds Corp. against Enbridge Gas 
Utah 

DOCKET NO. 26-057-05 

ORDER GRANTING MOTION 

ISSUED: April 13, 2026 

On March 12, 2026, Richard Timothy Branscomb on behalf of Sierra West 
Diamonds Corp. (“Complainant”) filed a Formal Complaint (“Complaint”) with the 
Public Service Commission (PSC) against Enbridge Gas Utah (EGU). On March 13, 
2026, the PSC issued a Notice of Filing and Comment Period, providing EGU until April 
13, 2026, to submit a written response to the Complaint, and allowing Complainant 
until April 28, 2026, to submit a written reply to any EGU written response. 

On April 13, 2026, EGU filed a Joint Stipulation to Stay and Extend Response 
Deadline (“Joint Motion”).1 The Joint Motion represents EGU and Complainant 
(“Parties”) are engaged in good-faith discussions and are pursuing informal resolution 
of issues raised in the Complaint. The Joint Motion asserts that the Parties believe that 
a limited stay of this proceeding will facilitate these efforts and may obviate the need 
for further proceedings before the PSC. Based on the foregoing the Parties jointly 
request that: 

1 Although the Joint Motion is dated April 10, 2026, the Joint Motion was initially filed with the PSC after 
business hours on Friday, April 10, 2026, then was subsequently “updated” and refiled on Sunday, April 
12, 2026. Thus, pursuant to Utah Admin. Code R746-1-204, the Joint Motion has a filing date of April 13, 
2026. 

DOCKET NO. 26-057-05 

- 2 - 

1. 
This proceeding be stayed for a period of thirty (30) days, or until May 13, 
2026; and 

2. 
EGU’s deadline to file its responsive pleading to the Complaint be 
extended by thirty (30) days, or until May 13, 2026. 
The Parties further represent that they will promptly notify the PSC if the matter is 
resolved during the foregoing stay period. However, the Joint Motion is silent on the 
deadline for Complainant’s written reply to any written response by EGU if this matter 
is not resolved. 

Accordingly, good cause appearing, and based on the representations in the 
Joint Motion, the Joint Motion is granted subject to the following: Complainant’s 
written reply to any written response submitted to the PSC by EGU on or before May 
13, 2026, shall be due fourteen (14) days after such EGU submission. 

DATED at Salt Lake City, Utah, April 13, 2026. 

/s/ John E. Delaney 
Presiding Officer
